title: typo3-backend-rights: the skill at work
description: Editor groups you can verify. Recorded from a read-only audit of this TYPO3 v14 lab and its Backend Users module. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 48 seconds: the typo3-backend-rights agent skill. A read-only audit of the TYPO3 lab prints its editor model as JSON: three groups, four administrators and 56 findings. The Backend Users module shows the groups. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: Editor rights grow for years. One wrong click, and the admin is locked out.
You ask for one main editor role with subgroups.
A read-only audit reads every group, module and page permission, and prints JSON.
The lab fails: three groups, no leaves, 56 findings.
A working administrator always stays. A lockout costs more than any permission gain.
